candidateEvidence.reconciliation: Keep existing exact {v:1,preimage,record} pair and reconciliation record fields/slots. Candidate observation preimage is a typed computer-use enabled boolean. finding=indeterminate with null basisDigest unless an exact retained request-linked completed/refused record proves terminal outcome. Current Boolean alone never proves applied/refused and never authorizes a second write.
candidateEvidence.durability: Logical durable file+directory flush and exact readback before completion; no physical-flush guarantee. A no-op still consumes/spends and completes before==after. Audit is best-effort and never retried.
